  • Experience with JSM Assets and configuration management databases (CMDBs).
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or similar enterprise IT service management platforms.
  • Experience with Rovo, AI agents, or AI-powered service workflows.
  • Experience with Python, Groovy, JavaScript, or ScriptRunner.
  • Experience integrating Atlassian products with Slack, identity providers, endpoint management tools, or monitoring platforms.
  • Experience building Confluence knowledge bases and integrating them into employee self-service experiences.

Durable Skills

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it). 

We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. 

We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management - Check out Shape, our construction management tech 

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. 

This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. 

4 core values for a good life 

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. So our values reflect the 4 levels of relationships that each of us has: 

  • Grow yourself – Your relationship with yourself
  • Care about people – Your relationship with others around you
  • Execute to greatness – Your relationship with your team
  • Build civilisation – Your relationship with humanity and the world 

This goes much deeper but for the sake of brevity, we will keep the summary version!

We enshrined our values in our vision

We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that: 

  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures 

We believe that, by first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. 

And enable the achievement of our vision through our dual missions: 

  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

_________________________________________________________________________________________

The Role 

Purpose of the role 

You're where every Shape deal starts, and one of the people who sets the standard for how we prospect. As you grow, you'll shape our messaging and set the bar for the SDRs who join after you. 

 

What the job actually is 

You know the job. Most of your day is on the phone, and you'll hear "no", "not now" and "just send me an email" more than anything else. Here, you'll be calling commercial, project and operations leaders at tier 1 and tier 2 construction firms (main contractors and the subcontractors who work for them). They're running live projects, their time is precious and they're wary of anyone selling software. Almost all of our pipeline is outbound, apart from customer referrals, so the meetings you book are ones you've created yourself.

You also know that to be good at cold calling, you have to genuinely love it. If you don't, and you plan to go through the motions, it's a boring job, and it shows on every call. We're looking for someone who still gets a buzz from turning a cold "who's this?" into a real conversation.

Quality over quantity, always. We care about the work we do and take pride in doing it properly, and we want people who feel the same. You'll know a booked meeting isn't the same as a good one. Here, it means understanding their problem properly: being curious enough to ask the second and third question, listening more than you talk, and knowing by the end of the call what's actually going wrong for them, on which project, and why it matters now. It also means only offering a solution to people who genuinely want or need to fix it. If they don't, you thank them and move on. Get that right and the meeting follows naturally, and it's one worth having.

 

How the team is set up

You'll sit in the UK sales team, working day to day with an Account Executive who takes your meetings forward to a free launch and then a contract. You open the door, they win the deal, and you succeed together. You'll work with a CRM, a dialler and call recording, plus a playbook, a library of calls that have actually won, and AI call-prep tools built for how we sell.

 

Where you'll work

Remote, anywhere in the UK, with the chance to attend industry events in person in the near future.

 

Why it's worth it 

  • A career in a market that's only just going digital: around $10 trillion is spent on construction every year, yet it's one of the least digitised industries in the world, and spending on construction management software is forecast to nearly double by 2030. People who can sell software and genuinely understand construction are rare. Learn both here, and you'll have skills that stay in demand for years as the industry catches up, and you'll be helping it work better along the way.
  • Senior conversations from the start: you'll be speaking directly to leaders at some of the UK's biggest construction firms, not working your way through gatekeepers.
  • Coaching that knows the industry: weekly reviews and coaching from people who've lived and breathed construction, on site, not just on the phones.
  • A playbook that works: built from calls that have won, so you're not starting from scratch.
  • Progression on merit: a proper conversation about your next step within a year, based on what you've shown.
  • You'll shape how we sell: what you learn and suggest makes it into the playbook.
  • A 4-day week: the same standards and targets, delivered in four days. 

 

Your top responsibilities 

  • Open doors: start proper conversations, every day, with the people who feel the problem and can decide.
  • Qualify properly: test the problem early, dig in before you pitch, and keep qualifying after the "yes".
  • Hand over cleanly: your CRM notes tell the story, so your Account Executive picks up exactly where you left off.
  • Be obsessed with your numbers: know them every day, track them weekly and act on what they tell you.
  • Raise the bar: once you're up to speed, share what's working, contribute to the playbook and help newer SDRs get better faster.
 
Your roadmap: your first 30 days and beyond 

You bring the experience. We'll make sure you're selling the Shape way, with confidence, by week 3 or 4. 

  • Before day 1, ready to go: your CRM, dialler, call recording and your own Shape login set up, so week 1 is spent learning.
  • Week 1, understand the why: the problems we solve, who for, and why it beats how contractors work today, with the product shown in action by Customer Success.
  • Week 2, build your pitch: write your first-call pitch, compare it with the winning calls in our library, get it reviewed, and make your first live calls if you're ready.
  • Weeks 3–4, up and running: calling daily with call reviews, booking your first meetings and handing them over properly.
  • By day 30: signed off as ready to call, every call in the library listened to, and your first measures reviewed with your manager.
  • Months 2–3, ramp: half the full target, with your own quality scorecard.
  • By the end of month 3, full target: the same target every SDR carries, in line with your probation period.
  • 6–12 months, step up: own a set of key accounts or a segment, help refine our messaging and set the bar for newer SDRs, with a clear path to Account Executive or SDR Team Lead.

 

Why three months is realistic: it's quick by industry standards, and that's deliberate. You won't be figuring it out alone. You'll have a playbook built from calls that have won, regular call reviews, weekly 1:1s and your own scorecard. Our best have been fully up to speed in a month. Training never stops at day 30, however experienced you are. 

 

How you'll be measured

Good numbers come from good conversations. You'll have your own monthly scorecard, built around three questions: are you reaching the right people, are those calls turning into real conversations, and are those conversations turning into meetings worth having? 

Your main target is qualified meetings attended: meetings that actually take place, where your Account Executive agrees there's a genuine opportunity. You'll know your numbers from day one, and we'll go through them with you every week. 

No grey areas: you and your Account Executive are partners. What makes a meeting qualified is written down and shared, so you'll both know where the bar is. If you ever see one differently, you talk it through with the call recording in front of you. Decisions come down to facts, never opinion or politics. 

What our best are doing: booking around 20% more meetings than target, turning conversations into meetings at nearly double the minimum rate, and keeping more people on the phone than our standard asks for, with almost every meeting qualified (92%) because they do the basics properly. That's the bar, and we'll help you get there. 

 

A start-up at a pivotal point

If you've ever wanted to join a start-up right as it takes off, this is that moment. We're past the early days: our sales process is working, customers are launching with us and we know what good looks like. Now we're growing, and the people who join now will shape what comes next.

You get the start-up stuff, the exciting and the real: things move fast, you'll build as you go, your ideas get heard (and actually used), and you'll see the impact of your work every week. We hold ourselves to a high standard, back each other up and enjoy it along the way.

We're looking for people in it for the long term, and that works both ways. We'll invest in you with weekly coaching, structured training and progression on merit. In return, we want people who want to build something with us over years, not a stepping stone.

 

Your Capabilities

Must haves:

  • Proven outbound experience at a senior level: 2+ years of phone-led B2B prospecting into directors and heads of department, in a complex sale where several people are involved in each decision and sales cycles are longer.
  • A track record: you've been at or above target for most of the last 12 months, and you can show it.
  • Your own toughest critic: you can listen back to your own call and say what worked, what didn't and what you'd change.
  • A forever learner: however good you get, you never feel you know enough. You're always looking for the next thing to learn, and you go after it. 

What we look for in you 

  • Numbers-obsessed: you know why your numbers are what they are: not just dials and meetings booked, but how many showed, how many qualified and what you changed when one dipped.
  • Quality over volume: you'd choose a better conversation over a faster one. You test the problem before you pitch and keep qualifying after the "yes".
  • Quick on your feet, and a genuine listener: calls rarely go word perfect. You think creatively, react to what's actually been said, and listen to understand. Construction people can spot a fake a mile off, and so can we.
  • A strategist who takes action: you plan who to call, when and why, run your own day and keep your CRM honest. Then you act, without waiting to be told.
  • You've done your homework: you understand the problems construction teams face, and you can say clearly why construction and why this job.
  • A sponge, with no ego: however good you are, you soak up how we do things here and take feedback on your calls. Egos stay at the door, on both sides. 

Why experience alone isn't enough 

Experience gets you an interview, but it isn't what gets you the job. We've seen numbers-first sales cultures produce full calendars and empty pipelines, so we're looking for experience that's still coachable. 

Nice to have (if you don't have it now, you will after joining) 

  • Experience selling into construction, engineering or infrastructure.
  • Having helped build or improve a playbook, sequence or messaging.
  • Start-up or scale-up experience.
  • Experience managing your own pipeline in a CRM and using diallers and other sales tools.
  • Construction site experience, or time working in the industry.
  • Full-cycle (360) sales experience, from first call through to close.

 Shape isn't the place for you if any of the following is true: 

  • You'd rather set the strategy and have someone else build the campaigns
  • You'd rather report on activity than be measured on booked demos
  • You want an easy role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don't like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

  • Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
  • Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
  • Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft

 

The Life-Changing Stuff

  • In-house coaching: Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being
  • Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected. 
  • Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists. 
  • Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
  • Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Important! Applying properly

Apply with your CV and a cover letter answering these three questions:
  1. Why construction, and why this job?
  2. What do you think are the biggest problems facing the people we'd have you calling?
  3. What's the number you're most proud of from your current or last role, and why? 

A note on AI: yes, we use it every day, and you're welcome to use it to research or sharpen your thinking. But right now this is about getting to know you, so make sure your answers sound like you. There are no wrong answers. We'd rather hear what you really think, even if it's not completely accurate. 

What happens next 

Every application is read by the people you'd work with. We move quickly, and you'll hear back at every stage. After an initial screen, there are three stages: 

  • Meet and greet: we get to know each other and make sure we're aligned on expectations, both yours and ours.
  • Mock call with feedback: a role-play cold call. We'll give you feedback and see how you use it. We'll prepare you for this, and nobody expects it to be perfect.
  • Meet the team, then a decision: meet the people you'd be working with every day. Then we'll give you a clear answer either way, with feedback.

L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.

Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 850 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.

Grâce à notre expérience du Lean et de la tech, combinées à notre connaissance de la santé, nous concevons et développons des dispositifs médicaux numériques qui s'intègrent dans le parcours de soins des patients (thérapies digitales - DTx, essais cliniques virtualisés, parcours de soins digitalisés). Notre but est de réaliser des produits qui changent la vie de leurs utilisateurs, qu'ils soient soignants ou patients.

Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 120 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien.

Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

Tes futures missions :
En tant que Software Engineer Fullstack chez Theodo, ta mission sera de concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.

Tout au long de tes projets, tu seras accompagné pour monter en compétences et apprendre à écrire du code de qualité, à comprendre les enjeux produit et à intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’une application, de la conception au déploiement.

Ce que tu vas apprendre en tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo :


  • Comprendre le problème de ton client et y répondre avec un produit performant, maintenable et orienté valeur, en intervenant sur tout le cycle de production, de la conception au déploiement
  • Produire du code de qualité dans les délais, en intégrant tests, refactoring et standards techniques de l’équipe, quelle que soit la technologie utilisée
  • Mener des investigations techniques, débugger efficacement et corriger les défauts de manière pérenne, dans tout type d’environnement
  • Analyser en profondeur des problèmes dans le code pour développer son esprit de résolution de problèmes
  • Travailler avec un LLM pour accélérer les développements




Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :

En 8 semaines, une équipe de 4 experts Theodo a conçu un POC de chatbot RAG connecté à la base Vidal, capable de réduire le temps de recherche tout en garantissant traçabilité et fiabilité des sources. Objectif : renforcer la confiance des praticiens et faire entrer Vidal dans l’ère du service médical “fonctionnel”

An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

  • Go

  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis and Sidekiq

We are looking for an Accountant that is excited about the below Mission and Outcome.

Mission: As an Accountant, you will play a key role in providing high-quality accounting services to our clients. This position is ideal for someone with 5 years of experience, preferably within practice, looking to deepen their expertise and take on new responsibilities in a fast-paced, cloud-based environment. Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

One Way Video Interview / TA Screening

•     Secure coding practices and application security.

•     Basic understanding of cryptography and cybersecurity.

Benefits

Internship – Market Data Announcements Tool Redesign & AI Assistance

Duration: 6 months

Start date: Early 2027 (flexible)

Location: Paris 7e


ABOUT CFM

Founded in 1991, we are a global quantitative and systematic asset management firm applying a scientific approach to finance to develop alternative investment strategies that create value for our clients.

We value innovation, dedication, collaboration, and the ability to make an impact. Together, we create a stimulating environment for talented and passionate experts in research, technology, and business to explore new ideas and challenge existing assumptions.


YOUR ROLE

Market Data – Front Office Support is responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy and timely availability of the market data that feeds the CFM trading activities. It operates at the intersection of data management, technology and finance, and relies on data from multiple external providers to drive diversified investment strategies.

The team relies on an internal web tool that centralizes announcements issued by several market data providers, matches them against the financial instruments referential, enables review and validation by business teams, and forwards them to a ticketing tool. Developed several years ago and recently migrated to newer infrastructure, the tool has never been fundamentally redesigned. It suffers from an aging architecture (hard to maintain, slow), fragile provider integrations, security debt, a poorly responsive UI with repetitive manual review steps, and no automated tests. As a result, operators spend a lot of time on manual reviews, and many announcements require little or no action.

The central project of your internship is to rebuild this application on a more robust, faster and more maintainable foundation, and to use LLM-based agents to assist operators in reviewing and processing announcements, so that they can focus only on the cases that truly require human attention.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Audit the existing tool and gather needs from Market Data operators.
  • Design a more robust, faster and maintainable architecture.
  • Build the new application (or an advanced prototype) and define a migration plan.
  • Secure access management and the handling of secrets and sensitive data.
  • Make external provider integrations reliable and resilient.
  • Automate repetitive tasks (imports, synchronizations, notifications).

Description du Poste

Les Missions

La personne recrutée aura pour mission d’assister les personnels de recherche du laboratoire dans le développement et la professionnalisation des logiciels liés à leurs travaux de recherche en informatique et intelligence artificielle. Elle aura la responsabilité de conduire et de réaliser les développements, de maintenir les logiciels développés, d’en assurer la diffusion notamment dans un esprit de science ouverte, et le cas échéant de contribuer à l’animation des communautés associées.

L'Activité

  • Prendre en charge tout ou partie de l'activité de gestion de projets logiciels en collaboration avec les personnels de recherche
  • Assurer le développement des logiciels en suivant les bonnes pratiques du génie logiciel
  • Élaborer les stratégies de test, concevoir, spécifier et exécuter des tests fonctionnels et/ou techniques
  • Assurer l’intégration des développements
  • Le cas échéant, participer à l’encadrement des équipes de développement dédiées aux projets de recherche
  • Rédiger les documentations techniques et fonctionnelles des logiciels développés
  • Assurer la maintenance évolutive et curative des développements réalisés
  • Le cas échéant, diffuser les logiciels sur des plateformes telles que Github / Gitlab
  • Assurer l’animation des communautés qui se formeront autour de l’usage des logiciels diffusés, notamment ceux sous licence libre.

Activités Complémentaires

  • Participation aux réunions de service
  • Contribution à la médiation scientifique dans le cadre de manifestations (conférences et colloques techniques, fête de la science, etc.)

Votre Profil

Compétences

Savoir (connaissances)

Le ou la candidate devra posséder une solide culture en développement logiciel, incluant notamment :

  • Bonne maîtrise d’un ou plusieurs langages de programmation usuels dans la recherche : Python, C++ mais aussi JavaScript/Typescript. Notions sur des frameworks associés (type React, Node.js, Pytorch, Tensorflow,…)
  • Connaissance des principes du génie logiciel, y compris les bonnes pratiques de développement, la modularité, la réutilisabilité, et les standards de codage
  • Maîtrise des systèmes de gestion de versions (notamment Git, GitLab/GitHub, etc.)
  • Connaissance des outils d’intégration continue et des environnements de développement collaboratifs
  • Connaissances en tests logiciels (tests unitaires, tests fonctionnels, tests d’intégration, couverture de test)
  • Sensibilité aux modèles de licences libres et aux principes de la science ouverte
  • Connaissance des enjeux liés à la soutenabilité, la qualité et la pérennité des logiciels
  • Connaissances de base en algorithmique et en intelligence artificielle

Savoir-faire (compétences Opérationnelles)

  • Analyser un besoin scientifique et en extraire des spécifications techniques pour un développement logiciel
  • Concevoir, documenter, développer, tester, maintenir et diffuser des logiciels robustes, maintenables et diffusables
  • Mettre en oeuvre une démarche rigoureuse de tests
  • Utiliser des outils de gestion de version et d’intégration continue dans le cadre de projets collaboratifs
  • Structurer un projet logiciel de manière à faciliter sa réutilisation et son appropriation par d’autres utilisateurs ou contributeurs
  • Interagir avec des chercheurs, doctorants et autres ingénieurs, comprendre leurs besoins et traduire des prototypes de recherche en produits logiciels plus mûrs
  • Assurer la maintenance évolutive et corrective de logiciels en production ou en diffusion libre
  • Mettre en oeuvre une démarche de documentation claire et adaptée (technique, utilisateur, API)
  • Si nécessaire, encadrer ou coordonner des petites équipes de développement ou de stagiaires

Savoir Être (compétences Comportementales)

  • Autonomie et capacité à mener un projet de développement du début à la fin
  • Rigueur et souci de la qualité logicielle
  • Esprit d’initiative et capacité à proposer des solutions techniques adaptées au contexte scientifique
  • Capacité à travailler en équipe, en interaction avec des chercheurs, d’autres ingénieurs, des doctorants, des élèves ingénieurs
  • Curiosité intellectuelle et goût pour les environnements pluridisciplinaires

Votre Environnement de Travail

La recherche technologique effectuée dans l'unité Heudiasyc s'appuie sur des plateformes expérimentales, situées au sein de l'université de technologie de Compiègne : véhicules intelligents et autonomes (Equipex+ Tirrex, laboratoire commun Sivalab avec Renault), drones aériens, ferroviaire et réalité virtuelle (Equipex+ Continuum).

L'unité Heudiasyc est structurée en trois équipes de recherche et deux services supports (effectif du laboratoire : 130 personnes), dont le service plateformes technologiques auquel sera rattaché l'ingénieur·e. Ce service gère les plateformes de l'unité, ainsi que les moyens informatiques communs de l'unité qui est entièrement en zone protégée ZRR (Zone à Régime Restrictif). La personne recrutée dépendra hiérarchiquement du responsable du service plateformes technologiques de l'unité.

Wil jij op operationeel niveau bouwen aan de mensen die het onderwijs van duizenden leerlingen versterken? Als Resource Manager bij Lyceo in Leiden krijg je een sleutelpositie binnen een landelijke marktleider die volop groeit. Een baan met directe impact, veel verantwoordelijkheid en volop ruimte om recruitment en capaciteitsmanagement verder te professionaliseren.

Taken

Maak het verschil als Resource Manager in Leiden

Als Resource Manager zorg je ervoor dat Lyceo nu en in de toekomst beschikt over de juiste begeleiders om scholen en leerlingen tijdig te ondersteunen. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor hun beschikbaarheid, kwaliteit en inzetbaarheid. Je maakt deel uit van het MT en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de directie van Lyceo. Met ondersteuning van het datateam bepaal je welke begeleiders waar en wanneer nodig zijn. Op basis daarvan laat je gerichte recruitmentacties uitvoeren en geef je richting aan selectie, matching en onboarding. Met KPI’s bewaak je de instroom, retentie, vervulling en doorlooptijden en stuur je gericht bij. Daarnaast optimaliseer je processen en geef je leiding aan een team met onder andere een Recruiter en een Coördinator Matching en Onboarding. Samen met de Operationeel Manager zorg je voor voldoende geschikte mensen en een succesvolle uitvoering van alle onderwijsprojecten. Bij afwezigheid kunnen jullie elkaars verantwoordelijkheden overnemen.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • realiseren van voldoende gerichte instroom en een kwalitatief sterke recruitment, selectie en onboarding;
  • verbinden van vraag en aanbod op basis van regio, vakgebied, onderwijstype, beschikbaarheid en reisbereidheid;
  • voorspellen, bewaken en bijsturen van de capaciteitsbehoefte met data en KPI’s;
  • optimaliseren van recruitment en instroomprocessen en adviseren over selectiecriteria, retentie en capaciteit;
  • aansturen van het team en bewaken van het recruitmentbudget.

Vereisten

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Je vertaalt recruitmentdoelstellingen naar concrete acties en stuurt met data op kwaliteit, instroom en capaciteit. Historische resultaten combineer je met verwachtingen en ontwikkelingen in de markt. Ook wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat, kijk je vooruit, maak je keuzes en stuur je tijdig bij. Als leidinggevende sta je dicht bij je team, geef je richting en neem je mensen met positieve energie mee. Ervaring binnen recruitment, arbeidsbemiddeling, detachering of vergelijkbare dienstverlening helpt je om wisselende capaciteitsvragen snel te doorgronden.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

  • minimaal hbo werk- en denkniveau;
  • ervaring met recruitment, werving en selectie;
  • leidinggevende ervaring binnen recruitment, capaciteitsmanagement of een vergelijkbare dienstverlenende omgeving;
  • ervaring met het sturen op data en KPI’s binnen recruitment of capaciteitsplanning;
  • ervaring met het optimaliseren van recruitment- of instroomprocessen.

Jouw werkgebied

Jouw nieuwe werkplek bevindt zich in Leiden, vlak bij Leiden Centraal. Vanuit het kantoor werk je nauw samen met de verschillende afdelingen van Lyceo. Dankzij de ligging nabij het centraal station is de werkplek goed bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer.

Benefits

Als gedreven Resource Manager kun jij rekenen op:

Een verantwoordelijke functie bij een groeiende onderwijsorganisatie waar ontwikkeling niet alleen voor leerlingen centraal staat. Lyceo biedt je ruimte voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën. Via de Lyceo Academie blijf je bovendien zelf leren en krijg je volop mogelijkheden om binnen de organisatie door te groeien.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

  • een verantwoordelijke functie van 32 tot 40 uur per week, waarbij je tijdens de drukke periodes in het schooljaar flexibel beschikbaar bent;
  • 25 vakantiedagen, waarvan je naar rato 10 vakantiedagen opneemt in de zomervakantie;
  • de mogelijkheid om 5 extra verlofdagen bij te kopen;
  • 8% vakantiegeld, uitbetaald in mei;
  • reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer of volledige vergoeding van OV-kosten;
  • een pensioenregeling waarbij Lyceo 6% premie betaalt;
  • een laptop en telefoon van de zaak;
  • toegang tot exclusieve kortingen via Benefits at Work;
  • deelname aan de Lyceo Academie met diverse online en fysieke trainingen;
  • volop mogelijkheden om door te groeien binnen Lyceo;
  • leuke activiteiten via onze personeelsvereniging Nablijven.

Werken bij Lyceo

Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is een toonaangevende landelijke organisatie in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen met onder andere huiswerkbegeleiding, bijspijkertrajecten, examentrainingen en lente- en zomerscholen. Scholen beoordelen de dienstverlening van Lyceo gemiddeld met een 8,5 of hoger.

Als marktleider is Lyceo volop in beweging en heeft de organisatie duidelijke groeiambities. Je werkt in een betrokken en energieke omgeving waarin samenwerking centraal staat en ruimte is voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën. Samen werkt Lyceo aan de beste verbinding tussen regulier en aanvullend onderwijs, zodat ieder kind tot zijn recht kan komen.

Eén klik verwijderd van jouw nieuwe baan

Gaat jouw hart sneller kloppen van deze vacature en heb je de checklist afgevinkt? Wacht dan niet te lang, want zodra wij een geschikte kandidaat hebben gevonden sluiten we de vacature. Solliciteren doe je simpel en snel via onze solliciteer-button. Vergeet je niet om een up-to-date cv en een gerichte motivatie toe te voegen? Heb je vragen over de vacature? Neem dan contact op met Jamie via telefoonnummer 06-82073897. Misschien spreken we elkaar dan snel!

About us

Bleu Robotics is an AI company developing universal AI software for the deployment of advanced robots , humanoids, mobile manipulators, and industrial arms, in real factories. The convergence of humanoid robotics and modern AI is one of the most significant technical opportunities of the decade, and most of the work today still happens in research settings. We are building the software layer required to bring it into operational use.

We have a strong ambition to become the next Microsoft to run on every industrial humanoid. We have closed our pre-seed round with Top-tier fund to deploy our robot in Tier 1 manufacturing facilities.

We are looking for deeply passionate scientists who can help us push the frontier and build a major lab in physical AI.

Our vision

To enable a robot to learn a new industrial task from a few demonstrations and operate autonomously, with under one hour between the start of the demonstration and the start of deployment.

This objective shapes our roadmap and every technical decision we make.

THE ROLE

We are hiring an ML Platform Engineer to put our robot learning stack in the cloud and own the full stack. The platform will let customers run our learning pipelines on their own data as a hosted service; its exact scope will evolve with the product.

You will be the first engineer at Bleu Robotics with cloud expertise. The scope covers infrastructure, training and inference services, the web front end, security, and cost. The choice of cloud provider and web framework is open; you will make it with the team.

The role is based in Paris and is on-site.

BACKGROUND

We are equally interested in two kinds of background:

  1. software or ML platform engineer who has built and operated a cloud service that runs training or inference jobs on data uploaded by users (e.g., an ML platform team, an MLOps product, a SaaS that runs compute on customer data).

  2. backend or full-stack engineer with solid DevOps experience who has shipped a web product on a major cloud provider and wants to work on robot learning.

Experience with robotics or robot learning is appreciated but not required. You will learn the learning stack from the team; the team will learn cloud practices from you.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design the architecture of the platform and select the cloud provider, orchestration layer, and web stack, in agreement with the team

  • Package our training and inference pipelines (Python, PyTorch) as cloud services: job scheduling, GPU provisioning, artifact storage, versioning of datasets and policies

  • Build the web application through which users upload data, follow training runs, and download policies, including its front end and API

  • Add interactive, browser-based components to the platform, including simulation, as the product evolves

  • Set up infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, and alerting for the platform

  • Implement authentication, per-customer isolation, and data protection for confidential industrial data

  • Control cloud costs: GPU usage, storage, and idle resources

  • Bring cloud and DevOps practices to the rest of the engineering team through documentation, reviews, and training

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree or PhD in computer science or a related field, followed by 2 to 3 years of professional experience building and operating a comparable cloud service

  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure, or a European provider such as Scaleway or OVHcloud)

  • Proficiency with containers and orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes or a managed equivalent) and with infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar)

  • Strong Python development skills for backend services, including asynchronous job execution

  • Front-end development experience with a modern web framework (React, Vue, Svelte, or similar), sufficient to ship the user-facing application yourself

  • Experience with CI/CD, monitoring, and security practices for a multi-tenant service

  • Comfortable working in Linux environments with Git

  • Professional proficiency in English, the official language of the team. Proficiency in French is not required; many of our employees do not speak French.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

The strongest candidates will combine cloud fluency with experience across several of the following:

  • ML infrastructure: training job orchestration, GPU scheduling, experiment tracking, model registries

  • PyTorch and the Python machine learning ecosystem

  • Physics simulation (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, or similar) and 3D rendering in the browser (WebGL, three.js)

  • Streaming interactive content to the browser (WebRTC or similar)

  • Data engineering for large volumes of video and time-series data

  • Security and compliance requirements of industrial customers: data residency, access control, audit logs

  • Cost optimization of GPU workloads

  • An early-stage startup, or a leading research lab (academic or industrial)

THE TEAM

The engineering team is a dozen top engineers and researchers in robotics and machine learning, organized around three focus areas: Integration, Vision & Perception, and Robot Learning. This position is the first cloud and platform role at Bleu Robotics. You will work with the whole team and with the founders on product decisions. Early hires help shape engineering practices, hiring, and culture.

  • A diverse fleet of advanced robots, including humanoids, on which to run your research

  • Research that ships: your algorithms run on real machines in real factories

  • Tight collaboration with engineering teams that take your work to production

  • Significant ownership of the research agenda as an early member of the team

  • A focused, technically strong team and a serious engineering culture

  • English-speaking working environment, no French required

  • Fair compensation + equity

Our Opportunity

Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.


Your Mission

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver.
You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath.
You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo.
Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties.

Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome


What you'll own

  • Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver.
  • Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact.
  • Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am.
  • Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access.
  • Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable.
  • Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure.
  • Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job.


What success looks like

  • You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use.
  • Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why.
  • You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it.
  • You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you.
  • You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how.


What it takes

  • You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast.
  • You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows.
  • You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy.
  • You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration.
  • You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem.
  • You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers.
  • You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them.
Bonus:

  • AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC.

  • LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows.

  • Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning.

  • Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it.

  • Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard.


Why Predium?

Datamint | Rust Systems Engineer, Browser Security | Remote (Global) | Full-time | $120k–$170k + Equity | https://datamint.xyz

We build high-throughput crawling and structured data extraction infra designed for AI agents and LLM pipelines.

If you’ve built scrapers recently, you already know the state of the market:

- Traditional proxy providers (Bright Data, Oxylabs, Smartproxy, Proxybase) give you raw IPs or massive unparsed HTML blobs, leaving you to deal with DOM bloat, token waste, and brittle parsing pipelines.

- Modern tools like Firecrawl or Jina made clean Markdown extraction easy for hobby setups, but they often struggle when you throw heavy SPAs, high-concurrency jobs, or hardened anti-bot walls (Cloudflare Under-Attack / Turnstile, Kasada, DataDome) at them.

- Rolling your own Playwright / Puppeteer cluster works until target sites deploy new JA4/TLS fingerprints, and your data team ends up spending 30% of their sprints fixing broken crawlers instead of shipping product.

We're tackling this by combining a low-latency Rust fast-fetch engine (JA4/TLS and HTTP/2 frame emulation) with an isolated stealth browser fleet, zero-code schema validation (JSON Schema/Pydantic), and native Model Context Protocol (MCP) support.

Trade-offs / where we fit: If you just need to curl a few static Wikipedia pages, a 10-line Python script is better and cheaper. But if you need reliable, structured data out of bot-defended sites without babying headless browsers, that's what we do.

We're looking for:

1. Rust Systems Engineer: High-concurrency network I/O, Axum/Tokio, TLS/BoringSSL fingerprinting, proxy routing matrices, and low-latency data pipelines.

2. Browser Security Engineer: Deep familiarity with browser internals (Firefox/Chromium source), canvas/WebGL/audio fingerprint evasion, CDP/WebDriver stealth, and familarity with anti-bot defenses.

Our stack: Rust, Next.js 16/React 19, TypeScript, hardened Firefox/dwx_crawler, Linux/Xvfb, SQLite WAL/Postgres.

If interested, shoot an email to jobs@datamint.xyz (or founders@datamint.xyz) with your GitHub, a project you built or broke, and what you find interesting in this space. No formal cover letter needed.

Employment type: Contractor or Contract-to-Hire
Location: Remote — Europe preferred; exceptional candidates considered globally
Compensation: Target range of USD $100,000–$140,000 annually, with flexibility up to approximately $200,000 for exceptional talent

About our Client

Our client is building an enterprise-ready AI coworker for procurement, legal, and sales teams. Its platform connects with the systems companies already use—including ERPs, contract platforms, email, and collaboration tools—to review contracts, surface risks, track obligations, and deliver grounded answers with citations to the underlying source data.

Rather than requiring customers to replace their existing workflows, Vallor integrates directly with their technology stack and helps teams automate contract review, negotiation, renewals, compliance, and value recovery.

Our client is an early-stage company with an 11-person team and a highly AI-native engineering culture. As the company expands its enterprise customer base, it is looking for a senior engineer who can combine excellent product engineering with ownership, customer empathy, and strong technical judgment.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Software Engineer who is highly proficient in TypeScript, strong on the backend, and comfortable contributing across the full stack.

You’ll join a small engineering team and take meaningful ownership of architecture, implementation, and delivery. Your initial work will support an important enterprise customer, requiring you to collaborate directly with stakeholders, translate their needs into product capabilities, and deliver high-quality solutions independently.

This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys early-stage environments, modern serverless architecture, customer-facing problem-solving, and AI-native software development.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and ship production features across Vallor’s TypeScript stack
  • Own backend services, APIs, integrations, data flows, and serverless infrastructure
  • Contribute to the frontend when needed using Next.js and TypeScript
  • Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their workflows and technical requirements
  • Translate customer needs into well-scoped, maintainable product features
  • Communicate tradeoffs, clarify requirements, and push back constructively when needed
  • Build integrations across enterprise systems, contract platforms, communication tools, and third-party APIs
  • Design and maintain serverless, event-driven systems on AWS
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code workflows using SST and related tooling
  • Use AI coding agents extensively to accelerate development and parallelize work
  • Review, test, debug, and improve AI-generated code rather than accepting raw output
  • Maintain a high standard for code quality, security, reliability, and maintainability
  • Help shape engineering practices and technical direction as the team grows
  • Identify opportunities beyond the initial customer requirements and turn them into valuable product improvements

What We’re Looking For

  • Senior or Staff-level software engineering experience
  • Deep professional experience with TypeScript
  • Strong backend engineering skills using Node.js, Bun, or similar runtimes
  • Ability to contribute across the full stack, including modern React or Next.js applications
  • Experience building and operating production systems on AWS
  • Strong understanding of serverless and event-driven architecture
  • Experience designing APIs, integrations, and distributed backend workflows
  • Experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code
  • Strong product judgment and ability to turn ambiguous needs into shipped solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Ability to work directly with customers and non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong organization, attention to detail, and project ownership
  • Experience using advanced AI coding tools or agents as a core part of daily development
  • Ability to critically review and take ownership of AI-generated code

Strong Advantages

  • Previous experience as a founding engineer or early-stage startup engineer
  • Experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering, implementation, or technical consulting role
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers
  • Deep knowledge of AWS infrastructure and systems architecture
  • Experience with SST, Pulumi, or comparable infrastructure-as-code tools
  • Experience coordinating multiple AI coding agents in parallel
  • Experience building enterprise AI products or workflow-automation platforms
  • Experience integrating with systems such as SAP, NetSuite, Salesforce, Snowflake, Microsoft 365, Slack, or contract lifecycle management platforms
  • Public projects, open-source contributions, or code samples that demonstrate engineering quality
  • Experience bringing structure and engineering maturity to a small, fast-growing team

Our client’s AI-Native Engineering Environment

Our client operates in a highly AI-native development environment, with the majority of code produced through AI-assisted workflows. Engineers are expected to go beyond basic autocomplete or occasional chatbot use.

The right candidate will know how to direct coding agents, break work into parallel streams, evaluate generated implementations, detect subtle problems, and ensure that every contribution meets production standards. The engineer—not the AI tool—remains accountable for the quality and correctness of the final product.

What Success Looks Like

During your first three months, you will become familiar with Vallor’s platform and take ownership of clearly defined deliverables for a major enterprise customer. You’ll work closely with internal and customer stakeholders to implement the functionality they need.

Over time, you’ll move beyond the initial roadmap: identifying unmet needs, proposing solutions, improving the platform’s architecture, and helping Vallor scale its product and engineering organization.

Interview Process

The process is designed to move quickly and may include:

  1. Initial conversation with Vallor’s leadership
  2. Technical conversation with the CTO
  3. Final combined interview
  4. Review of a project or code sample
  5. Professional reference checks

G2i technical, TypeScript, agentic coding, and communication assessments may be used to streamline the interview process.

L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. 
 
La practice AI Build accompagne les entreprises de tous secteurs dans la conception et le développement d’applications web sur-mesure. Habitués à intervenir au sein d’écosystèmes IT existants, nous intégrons nos solutions avec des outils imposés - ERP, CRM, plateformes métiers complexes - et savons nous intégrer efficacement dans les systèmes développés par nos clients.

Ton équipe :
Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 120 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien.
 
Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.
 
Tes futures missions :
En tant que Software Engineer Fullstack chez Theodo, ta mission sera de concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.
 
Tout au long de tes projets, tu seras accompagné pour monter en compétences et apprendre à écrire du code de qualité, à comprendre les enjeux produit et à intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’une application, de la conception au déploiement.
 
Ce que tu vas apprendre en tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo :
  • Comprendre le problème de ton client et y répondre avec un produit performant, maintenable et orienté valeur, en intervenant sur tout le cycle de production, de la conception au déploiement.
  • Produire du code de qualité dans les délais, en intégrant tests, refactoring et standards techniques de l’équipe, quelle que soit la technologie utilisée.
  • Mener des investigations techniques, débugger efficacement et corriger les défauts de manière pérenne, dans tout type d’environnement.
  • Analyser en profondeur des problèmes dans le code pour développer son esprit de résolution de problèmes
  • Travailler avec un LLM pour accélérer les développements
 
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
 
  • iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning.
  • Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires. Deux équipes produit ont piloté la reconstruction des plateformes de bout en bout, rejointes en fin de projet par une équipe data pour structurer et valoriser les données. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle, impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité.
 
Parmi les technos les plus représentées sur nos projets, tu pourras être amené à travailler avec : Java (Spring Boot), Angular, Node (Nest), React (Next), Python… 
 
Tes perspectives d'évolution :
Notre ambition est de former les leaders de la tech de demain. Grâce au coaching et formations que l’on propose, tu pourras :
  • Devenir un expert en développement en étant formé aux meilleurs standards de qualité
  • Développer des compétences transverses : coaching, recrutement, commercial, management et marketing technique
  • Participer à des groupes d’expertises avec d’autres passionnés (Cybersécurité, Serverless, Performance, GreenIT…)
  • Construire ton parcours sur-mesure pour atteindre tes objectifs : tech lead, senior architecte, évangéliste (spécialiste d’un sujet), CTO ou fondateur d’une entité etc
 
Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :
Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.
 
Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.
 
Profil recherché :
Nous recherchons avant tout des potentiels plus que des compétences déjà acquises. Si tu n’es pas encore un·e développeur·se chevronné·e, ce n’est pas un frein : ne te retiens pas pour postuler.
 
  • Tu es diplômé·e d’une top école d’ingénieur
  • Tu as entre 0 et 2 ans d'expérience
  • Tu aimes travailler en équipe et intéragir avec des profils et des métiers variés, en faisant preuve de pédagogie et d’esprit constructif (revues de code, pair programming)
  • Tu es orienté·e création de valeur : tu t’intéresses à l’activité du client et tu ne fais pas de la tech pour la tech
  • Tu es promoteur de l’IA, notamment sur les sujets de GenAI, et tu cherches à progresser en continu grâce à la veille technique
  • Tu fais preuve d’exigence sur la qualité du travail produit et sais questionner, voire interrompre, la chaîne de production lorsque nécessaire (#jidoka)
  • Tu aimes travailler de manière structurée et appliques naturellement des principes d’organisation et d’amélioration continue (inspirés du 5S)
  • Tu souhaites évoluer dans un environnement qui encourage au quotidien l’envie de progresser, l’esprit d’équipe et la prise d’initiative
 
Le processus de recrutement :
  • Un premier call de 30 minutes avec un recruteur
  • Un échange d’une heure avec le même recruteur
  • Un exercice de refactoring à effectuer chez toi, suivi d’un échange avec un tech lead pour revenir sur tes erreurs
  • Un exercice en direct de debuging
  • Un entretien dirigeant de 30 minutes pour revenir sur tes motivations à rejoindre Theodo et répondre à tes derniers questions
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ?
L’environnement:
💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 700 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités
🤝  Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires.
🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…)
🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel
 
Le package :
📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe
💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor
🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…)
🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...)
🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an
🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50%
🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Data Engineer on the Foundational team, you will serve as the "plumber" for deep learning, building the massive, high-performance data infrastructure required to power our foundational models. Based in Paris, you will manage terabytes—and eventually petabytes—of raw, unstructured, and noisy video data (EO and IR). Your mission is to ensure our ML engineers spend their time designing architectures, not waiting for data loaders or wrangling corrupted files.

 

Responsibilities

  • Multi-Modal Ingestion Pipeline: Build ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, decode, and store raw Electro-Optical (EO) and Infrared (IR) video from field logs into highly optimised formats like WebDataset, TFRecords, or Parquet.

  • Sensor Synchronisation & Alignment: Develop algorithms to programmatically synchronise EO and IR frames temporally and spatially to provide paired inputs for model training.

  • High-Throughput Data Loading: Architect storage-to-GPU pipelines to ensure multi-node training clusters maintain >90% GPU utilisation without I/O bottlenecks.

  • Distributed Processing: Write and optimise distributed data processing jobs using tools like Apache Spark, Ray, or Apache Beam to process thousands of hours of tactical video logs.

  • Data Quality & Versioning: Implement automated quality checks to filter corrupted or blank frames and maintain 100% reproducible training runs through robust versioning and lineage tracking.

  • Infrastructure Evaluation: Assess and implement advanced storage solutions (e.g., MinIO, S3 tiering) to manage growing datasets while optimising for cost and latency.

     

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: A BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Distributed Systems is highly preferred. Deep knowledge of operating systems, networking, and parallel computing is essential.

  • Technical Experience: 5-6+ years of experience building and maintaining terabyte-scale pipelines for unstructured data (video, images, or point clouds).

  • Performance Optimisation: Proven track record of maximising multi-node GPU utilisation and optimising data loaders for frameworks like PyTorch or JAX.

  • Tooling Expertise: Strong command of distributed computing tools (Spark, Ray, Beam) and ML data versioning tools (DVC, Apache Iceberg, or Pachyderm).

  • Adaptability & Ownership: A systems-thinker who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and views messy data as an engineering problem to be solved via automation.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
